nicknames: Stone of Courage and Truth (trade phrase)
lore_en: Amazonite is a teal-green variety of microcline feldspar named after the Amazon River region — although, despite the name, it has never actually been mined there. Its soothing blue-green color has made it a favorite for beads and carvings since antiquity, and today it is just as popular in jewelry and interior styling.
lore_zh: 天河石是一种蓝绿色的微斜长石，因亚马逊河流域得名——但有趣的是，它其实从未在亚马逊开采过。它柔和的蓝绿色自古以来就是珠串和雕件的宠儿，如今在珠宝与家居陈设中同样受欢迎。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, amazonite is known as a stone of truth and harmonious communication, traditionally believed to balance the heart and throat chakras. Many people keep it nearby during difficult conversations, and US crystal references also list it for luck and manifestation work.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，天河石被称为真诚与和谐沟通之石，传统上认为它能平衡心轮与喉轮。许多人在艰难对话前会把它放在身边；美国水晶资料也将其列入好运与显化（manifestation）用途。
uses_en: Desk stone for calm communication, interior styling accents, meditation on speaking one's truth, pocket stone on tense days.
uses_zh: 办公桌上的冷静沟通石、家居软装配色、练习表达真实想法的冥想石、紧张日子里的随身口袋石。
viral_hook_en: No single viral format — but its photogenic teal color performs well in 'crystal haul' and color-themed show content.
viral_hook_zh: 没有单一爆款形式，但上镜的青绿色在'水晶开箱 haul'和同色系主题直播中表现很好。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who has a hard conversation or a big presentation coming up.
gift_angle_zh: 送给即将进行一场艰难对话或重要演讲的朋友。

nicknames: The world's most popular purple crystal
Stone of Peace and Sobriety (card copy)
lore_en: Its name comes from the Greek amethystos, 'not drunk' — the ancient Greeks believed it prevented drunkenness and drank wine from amethyst goblets. The famous Bacchus myth is actually a 16th-century French poem, often retold as if it were ancient. Amethyst was also one of the twelve stones of the Priestly Breastplate, and bishops' rings still use it as a symbol of abstinence. It is the February birthstone.
lore_zh: 名字源于希腊语 amethystos，意为'不醉'——古希腊人相信它能防止醉酒，并用紫水晶酒杯饮酒。著名的酒神巴克斯传说其实出自 16 世纪的一首法国诗歌，后人常误当成古希腊神话。紫水晶也是祭司胸牌十二石之一，主教戒指至今仍用它象征节制。它是二月生辰石。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, amethyst is known as a powerful protective stone that enhances spiritual awareness, promotes calm, and supports meditation. Many people place it by the bed to support restful sleep, and it carries a long tradition as the 'sobriety stone.' It is widely recommended as one of the best entry points for any crystal collection.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，紫水晶被视为强大的保护石，传统上认为能提升灵性觉知、带来平静并辅助冥想。许多人把它放在床头以支持安稳睡眠，它也长期承载着'清醒之石'的传统。它被普遍推荐为水晶收藏的入门首选之一。
uses_en: Nightstand stone for sleep, meditation, a beginner's first crystal, statement geodes and cathedrals for home display.
uses_zh: 助眠床头石、冥想石、新手第一块水晶、家居陈列的晶洞与'大教堂'摆件。
viral_hook_en: Amethyst geodes and cathedrals are Whatnot auction staples; 'amethyst under $X' haul videos are a proven format.
viral_hook_zh: 紫晶洞和'大教堂'是 Whatnot 拍卖的常驻压轴款；'XX 美元以内的紫水晶'开箱视频是被验证过的内容形式。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who is starting a meditation practice — or who could use better sleep.
gift_angle_zh: 送给刚开始冥想练习、或需要更好睡眠的朋友。

lore_en: Apatite takes its name from the Greek apatao, 'to deceive,' because its crystals were historically mistaken for other minerals such as peridot and beryl. The blue variety from Madagascar is the one most commonly seen in the US crystal market.
lore_zh: 磷灰石的名字源于希腊语 apatao，意为'欺骗'，因为它的晶体历史上常被误认为橄榄石、绿柱石等其他矿物。美国市场上最常见的是马达加斯加产的蓝色磷灰石。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, blue apatite is known as a motivational, inspirational stone — often called a 'stone of manifestation' because it is traditionally believed to bridge future goals and present reality. US sellers list it for motivation, clearing confusion, and stimulating the intellect, and it is associated with the throat and third eye chakras.
metaphysical_zh: 在美国水晶圈，蓝磷灰石被称为激励与灵感之石——常被称为'显化之石'，因为传统上认为它能把未来目标与当下行动连接起来。美国卖家将它列为提升动力、驱散迷茫、激发智识的石头，对应喉轮与眉心轮。
uses_en: Goal-setting rituals, study and work focus, manifestation grids, a pocket stone before public speaking.
uses_zh: 目标设定仪式、学习与工作专注石、显化晶阵、公众演讲前的随身石。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend chasing a big goal who needs momentum.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正在追逐大目标、需要推一把动力的朋友。

nicknames: Stone of the Sea / Mermaid Stone (marketing)
lore_en: Its name is Latin for 'water of the sea' — aqua marina. Sailors carried it as a talisman to calm turbulent seas and protect against drowning. A member of the beryl family (alongside emerald), it is the March birthstone.
lore_zh: 名字源于拉丁语 aqua marina，意为'海水'。水手们随身携带它作为护身符，祈求平息风浪、免遭溺水。它与祖母绿同属绿柱石家族，是三月生辰石。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, aquamarine is associated with courage, serenity, and clear communication. Many people reach for it in anxiety moments, and it is a classic throat chakra stone for speaking calmly and honestly.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，海蓝宝与勇气、宁静和清晰沟通相关联。许多人在焦虑时刻会握住它，它也是经典的喉轮石，帮助人平静而坦诚地表达。
uses_en: Public speaking prep, a calming stone for stressful moments, March birthday gifts, ocean-themed styling.
uses_zh: 公众演讲准备、压力时刻的安抚石、三月生日礼物、海洋主题陈设。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a March birthday — or a friend with stage fright.
gift_angle_zh: 送给三月生日的朋友，或有'舞台恐惧症'的朋友。

lore_en: Aragonite is a calcium carbonate mineral named after Aragon, Spain, and is the orthorhombic sibling of calcite. Its most famous habit is the star-shaped cluster — sold in the trade as 'aragonite stars' or 'sputniks' — mostly from Morocco.
lore_zh: 文石是一种碳酸钙矿物，因西班牙阿拉贡地区得名，是方解石的斜方晶系'兄弟'。它最著名的晶形是星形晶簇——业内称为'文石星'或'卫星簇'——多产自摩洛哥。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, aragonite is valued for its grounding properties and connection to Earth energy — HealingCrystals.com calls it a 'good Earth healer.' It is traditionally used as a stabilizing stone for grounding through the root chakra, promoting patience, and releasing issues from the past.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，文石以接地（grounding）和连接大地能量著称——HealingCrystals.com 称它为'优秀的大地疗愈石'。传统上它被用作稳定石，通过海底轮帮助人扎根、培养耐心、放下过去的包袱。
uses_en: Grounding meditation, earth-energy grids, desk or workplace placement to stay steady on long projects; the star cluster form is the display and auction hook.
uses_zh: 接地冥想、大地能量晶阵、办公桌或工作区摆放以稳住长期项目；星形晶簇本身就是陈列与拍卖的视觉钩子。
viral_hook_en: The star/sputnik cluster itself is the visual hook — great for 'guess what this mineral is' reveal shots.
viral_hook_zh: 星形'卫星'晶簇本身就是视觉钩子——适合拍'猜猜这是什么矿物'的悬念开箱。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who feels scattered and needs to feel rooted.
gift_angle_zh: 送给感到心力分散、需要'扎下根来'的朋友。

name_zh: 极光水晶（天使极光系列）
nicknames: Opal Aura / Pearl Aura / Rainbow Aura
lore_en: Aura quartz is natural quartz permanently bonded with precious metals (platinum, silver, gold, titanium) in a vacuum chamber at around 1,600°F. The process emerged from the 1980s New Age movement, and reputable US sellers disclose it openly: the crystal is natural, the metals are natural, but the combination is an enhancement. It must never be sold as untreated.
lore_zh: 极光水晶是天然水晶在约 1600°F 的真空舱中与贵金属（铂、银、金、钛）永久键合而成。这一工艺诞生于 1980 年代的新纪元运动，负责任的美国卖家都会公开说明：水晶是天然的、金属是天然的，但结合过程属于人工增强。绝不可当作未处理天然品销售。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, angel aura is known as a 'crystal of joy' — traditionally believed to uplift the mood, cleanse the aura, support angelic communication, and align all chakras. Sellers frame it as a blend of science and nature: modern alchemy.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，天使极光被称为'喜悦水晶'——传统上认为它能提振情绪、净化气场、支持与天使的沟通并校准全部脉轮。卖家把它定位为科学与自然的结合：现代炼金术。
uses_en: Meditation, mood-lifting display, 'high vibe' decor. Care note: avoid water, salt, and direct sunlight or the plating can dull.
uses_zh: 冥想、提振情绪的陈列、'高频'家居装饰。养护提示：避免接触水、盐和阳光直射，否则镀层会黯淡。
viral_hook_en: The iridescent shine is made for close-up content; honest disclosure itself is trust-building content ('yes, it is enhanced — here is how').
viral_hook_zh: 彩虹光泽天生适合特写镜头；坦诚说明工艺本身也是建立信任的内容（'是的，它经过增强——工艺是这样的'）。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who loves all things iridescent and angelic.
gift_angle_zh: 送给热爱一切彩虹光泽与天使元素的朋友。

lore_en: Black tourmaline (schorl) is a boron silicate and by far the most common color of tourmaline; it also grows as needles inside quartz, sold as 'tourmalinated quartz.' The tourmaline group is piezoelectric — it builds an electric charge under pressure — which US sellers love to mention.
lore_zh: 黑碧玺（电气石中的 schorl 品种）是一种硼硅酸盐矿物，是碧玺中最常见的颜色；它还常以针状晶体生长在水晶内部，即'碧玺发晶'。碧玺家族具有压电性——受压会产生电荷——这是美国卖家津津乐道的知识点。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, black tourmaline is THE protection stone — called 'one of the most powerful protective stones in the mineral kingdom.' It is traditionally used for energetic shielding and grounding, and it is popular in the EMF-conscious community (lifestyle framing only — it is not a medical device).
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，黑碧玺是公认的第一保护石——被称为'矿物王国中最强大的保护石之一'。传统上用于能量屏蔽与接地，在关注电磁辐射（EMF）的生活方式社群中也很流行（仅限生活方式框架——它不是医疗器械）。
uses_en: Entryway placement, desk near electronics, car or pocket stone, foundation stone of any protection grid.
uses_zh: 入户门摆放、电子设备旁的桌面石、车内或口袋随身石、任何保护晶阵的基石。
viral_hook_en: WiFi-router placement videos and front-door protection grids are proven content formats.
viral_hook_zh: 路由器旁摆放视频和大门口保护晶阵都是被验证过的内容形式。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend moving into a new home — the classic front-door protection stone.
gift_angle_zh: 送给乔迁新居的朋友——经典的门口保护石。

lore_en: Blue lace agate is a delicate light-blue banded chalcedony whose fine white lace-like bands give it its name. It is one of the classic 'soothing blue' stones of the US market.
lore_zh: 蓝纹玛瑙是一种淡雅的浅蓝色条带玉髓，细腻如蕾丝的白色纹路是它的名字由来。它是美国市场经典的'治愈蓝'石头之一。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, blue lace agate supports peaceful communication and stress relief and is linked to the throat chakra. It is often recommended to people who suffer stage fright or dread difficult conversations — a stone for verbalizing yourself gently.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，蓝纹玛瑙有助于平和沟通、缓解压力，对应喉轮。它常被推荐给害怕公开演讲或畏惧艰难对话的人——一块帮助你温柔表达自我的石头。
uses_en: Public speaking prep, difficult conversations, a calming bedside stone.
uses_zh: 公众演讲准备、艰难对话前的陪伴、安抚情绪的床头石。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who freezes up in meetings or hates public speaking.
gift_angle_zh: 送给开会容易紧张、害怕公开发言的朋友。

name_zh: 方解石（蓝/橙/蜜糖/绿/光学）
lore_en: Calcite is calcium carbonate (CaCO₃), named from the Latin calx, 'lime.' It is soft (Mohs 3) and comes in a huge color range. Optical calcite — Iceland Spar — splits light into a double image, one of mineralogy's most famous optical tricks.
lore_zh: 方解石即碳酸钙（CaCO₃），名字源于拉丁语 calx（石灰）。它硬度较低（莫氏 3），颜色极为丰富。光学方解石——即'冰洲石'——能把光线拆成双重影像，是矿物学最著名的光学现象之一。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, calcite is an energy amplifier and cleanser, and US practice color-codes it: orange for creativity and the sacral chakra, blue for calm and emotional recovery, green for heart balance, honey for confidence, and optical calcite for clarity — 'seeing double truth.'
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，方解石是能量放大器与净化石，美国玩法按颜色分工：橙色对应创造力与脐轮，蓝色对应平静与情绪恢复，绿色对应心轮平衡，蜜糖色对应自信，光学方解石对应清明——'看见双重真相'。
uses_en: Affordable, colorful entry-level stones; chakra-color sets; big visual size per dollar for auctions. Care: soft and sensitive to water and acids.
uses_zh: 平价多彩的入门石、脉轮配色套装、拍卖场上'视觉体积/美元'最高的填充款。养护：硬度低，怕水怕酸。
viral_hook_en: Optical calcite's double-image trick is a ready-made demo video.
viral_hook_zh: 光学方解石的'双重影像'就是现成的演示视频素材。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend building their first chakra-color set on a budget.
gift_angle_zh: 送给想用低预算集齐第一套脉轮色系的朋友。

lore_en: This orange-red chalcedony has been treasured since ancient Egypt for its associations with vitality and courage; its name comes from the Latin carneus, 'flesh-colored.' Crystals.com named it their 2026 Crystal of the Year.
lore_zh: 这种橙红色玉髓自古埃及时期就因活力与勇气的寓意备受珍视；名字源于拉丁语 carneus，意为'肉色'。Crystals.com 将其评为 2026 年度水晶。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, carnelian is the sacral chakra stone of vitality, courage, creativity, and motivation. Many people keep it at the workspace for creative momentum and reach for it before performing.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，红玉髓是对应脐轮的活力、勇气、创造力与动力之石。许多人把它放在工作台上为创作蓄能，表演前也会握一握它。
uses_en: Creativity boost at the desk, confidence before performing, warm-toned jewelry and bracelets.
uses_zh: 工作台的创造力助推、表演前的自信石、暖色系珠宝与手链。
viral_hook_en: Its '2026 Crystal of the Year' title is a timely content hook; courage-stack bracelet content performs.
viral_hook_zh: '2026 年度水晶'的头衔是应景的内容钩子；'勇气叠戴'手链内容表现不错。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend starting a creative project or a new job.
gift_angle_zh: 送给刚启动创作项目或新工作的朋友。

lore_en: Celestite is a pale-blue strontium sulfate whose name comes from the Latin caelestis, 'heavenly' — a nod to its sky-blue color. The finest geode clusters come from Madagascar, and the mineral is also the principal ore of strontium, the element behind red fireworks. It is soft (Mohs 3–3.5) and its color can fade in sunlight.
lore_zh: 天青石是一种淡蓝色的硫酸锶矿物，名字源于拉丁语 caelestis，意为'天上的'——呼应它的天蓝色。最好的晶洞簇产自马达加斯加；它还是锶元素的主要矿石，红色烟花的颜色就来自锶。它硬度低（莫氏 3–3.5），颜色在阳光下会褪。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, celestite is associated with angelic communication, serenity, and higher consciousness — US sellers list it for stress relief, uplifting energy, and sleep support. Many people describe a lightness and calm around it, and it is a popular 'high vibration' stone for peaceful, restful spaces.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，天青石与天使沟通、宁静和更高意识相关联——美国卖家将它列为缓解压力、提振能量与支持睡眠的石头。许多人形容它带来轻盈与平静，是营造安宁空间的'高频'石。
uses_en: Bedside 'angel stone,' meditation rooms, nursery calm (a popular gift framing), gentle dream work.
uses_zh: 床头'天使石'、冥想空间、婴儿房宁静礼物（流行的送礼框架）、温和的梦境练习。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who wants a calmer bedroom — or a new-baby gift for the nursery.
gift_angle_zh: 送给想让卧室更安宁的朋友，或作为新生儿礼物装点婴儿房。

name_zh: 梦幻紫水晶（雪佛龙紫晶）
lore_en: Chevron amethyst is a natural banded combination of amethyst and white quartz grown in V-shaped 'chevron' layers. The US trade mostly sells it under the name Dream Amethyst — and the name tells you exactly how it is marketed.
lore_zh: 雪佛龙紫晶是紫水晶与白水晶天然共生、呈 V 形'人字纹'条带的品种。美国市场主要以'梦幻紫晶'（Dream Amethyst）的名字销售——名字本身就说明了它的营销方向。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, dream amethyst carries the amethyst story turned up a notch: the white quartz is said to amplify the amethyst. It is traditionally used for third-eye activation, intuition, lucid dreaming, dream recall, and restful sleep — 'one of the best stones for stimulating intuitive powers.'
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，梦幻紫晶被视为紫水晶故事的'加强版'：据说白水晶能放大紫水晶的能量。传统上用于激活眉心轮、提升直觉、清明梦、梦境回忆与安稳睡眠——'激发直觉力量的最佳石头之一'。
uses_en: Under the pillow or on the nightstand for dream work, third-eye meditation, dream journaling.
uses_zh: 枕头下或床头的梦境练习石、眉心轮冥想、梦境日记。
viral_hook_en: 'Put this under your pillow' sleep/dream TikTok; chevron pattern reveal shots.
viral_hook_zh: '把它放在枕头下'的睡眠/梦境类 TikTok；人字纹图案的开箱特写。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who keeps a dream journal.
gift_angle_zh: 送给坚持记梦境日记的朋友。

lore_en: Citrine is yellow quartz named from the French citron, 'lemon,' and it is the November birthstone. Natural citrine is rare — much of the market is heat-treated amethyst, a fact US knowledge sites discuss openly. Heat-treated material must always be labeled as such.
lore_zh: 黄水晶是黄色石英，名字源于法语 citron（柠檬），是十一月生辰石。天然黄水晶稀少——市场上大量产品其实是热处理紫水晶，美国科普网站对此公开讨论。热处理料必须如实标注。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, citrine is the Merchant's Stone — traditionally used in manifestation and abundance rituals to attract prosperity and success, and known for sunny joy and confidence. A widely repeated folk claim says it never needs cleansing. The classic US shop ritual: a citrine in the cash register or wallet.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，黄水晶是'商人之石'——传统上用于显化与丰盛仪式以招引富足与成功，也以阳光般的喜悦与自信著称。'永远不需要净化'是流传很广的民间说法。美国店铺的经典仪式：收银台或钱包里放一块黄水晶。
uses_en: Cash register / wallet / desk placement, manifestation rituals, confidence work.
uses_zh: 收银台/钱包/办公桌摆放、显化仪式、自信练习。
viral_hook_en: 'Money corner' desk setups; the natural-vs-heat-treated debate makes great live content.
viral_hook_zh: '财位角'办公桌布置；天然 vs 热处理之辩是绝佳的直播内容。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend opening a shop or launching a business — the classic 'citrine in the till.'
gift_angle_zh: 送给开店或创业的朋友——经典的'收银台黄水晶'。

lore_en: Clear quartz is pure silicon dioxide, known since antiquity as 'rock crystal' and shaped into crystal balls and talismans for centuries. Its clarity made it the default image of 'crystal' in the Western imagination.
lore_zh: 白水晶是纯净的二氧化硅，自古被称为'rock crystal'（晶石），几个世纪以来被磨成水晶球和护身符。它的澄澈让它成为西方人想象中'水晶'的默认形象。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, clear quartz is the Master Healer — it works on body, mind, and soul, acts as a natural amplifier, and is traditionally believed to elevate the properties of other stones. It can be 'programmed' with any intention and works with all chakras.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，白水晶是'疗愈大师'（Master Healer）——作用于身心灵，是天然的放大器，传统上认为能提升其他水晶的能量。它可被'编程'注入任何意图，并与所有脉轮协同。
uses_en: Meditation, amplifier in bundles and grids, intention programming, the universal first-crystal gift.
uses_zh: 冥想、套装与晶阵中的放大器、意图编程、万能的'第一块水晶'礼物。
viral_hook_en: 'Program your crystal' intention-setting content; towers and spheres are auction bread-and-butter.
viral_hook_zh: '为你的水晶编程'意图设定内容；塔和球是拍卖场的基本盘。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend buying their very first crystal — the universal starter stone.
gift_angle_zh: 送给准备入手人生第一块水晶的朋友——万能的入门石。

lore_en: Fluorite is calcium fluoride, named from the Latin fluere, 'to flow,' because it was used as a flux in smelting. It is famous for perfect cubic crystals and rainbow color banding — and it literally gave us the word 'fluorescence.'
lore_zh: 萤石即氟化钙，名字源于拉丁语 fluere（流动），因为它曾被用作冶炼助熔剂。它以完美的立方体晶体和彩虹色带闻名——英语'荧光'（fluorescence）一词就因它而来。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, fluorite is the Genius Stone — traditionally used for mental clarity, focus, organization, and decision-making. Purple fluorite is linked to the third eye, green fluorite to the heart, and it is the classic study-and-desk stone.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，萤石是'天才石'（Genius Stone）——传统上用于头脑清晰、专注、条理与决断。紫萤石对应眉心轮，绿萤石对应心轮，是经典的学习与办公桌石。
uses_en: Desk and study stone, exam season, work focus, 'mental decluttering,' photogenic rainbow towers.
uses_zh: 书桌与学习石、考试季、工作专注、'头脑断舍离'、上镜的彩虹塔。
viral_hook_en: Rainbow fluorite tower color-band close-ups are extremely photogenic; UV fluorescence reveals are a bonus format.
viral_hook_zh: 彩虹萤石塔的色带特写极其上镜；紫外荧光反应是加分的演示形式。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a student friend in exam season.
gift_angle_zh: 送给考试季的学生朋友。

lore_en: Garnet takes its name from the Latin granatum, 'pomegranate,' for its red seed-like crystals. It is a whole mineral group that occurs in nearly every color, and it is the January birthstone.
lore_zh: 石榴石的名字源于拉丁语 granatum（石榴），因红色籽粒状晶体得名。它是一整个矿物族，几乎涵盖所有颜色，是一月生辰石。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, garnet is a stone of passion, vitality, and commitment — devotion, love, stability, and an even flow of energy through the root chakra. It is a traditional gift for love that is meant to last.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，石榴石是热情、活力与承诺之石——忠诚、爱、稳定，以及经由海底轮的平稳能量流动。它是传统的'长久之爱'赠礼。
uses_en: January birthday gifts, commitment and anniversary gifts, vitality pocket stone.
uses_zh: 一月生日礼物、承诺与纪念日礼物、活力随身石。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a January birthday — or an anniversary gift about commitment.
gift_angle_zh: 送给一月生日的朋友，或作为寓意承诺的纪念日礼物。

lore_en: Green aventurine is green quartz sparkling with fuchsite mica inclusions — an effect called aventurescence. Its name comes from the Italian a ventura, 'by chance,' a name originally tied to goldstone glass discovered by accident.
lore_zh: 绿东陵是含铬云母（fuchsite）包裹体的绿色石英，闪耀的砂金效应称为 aventurescence。名字源于意大利语 a ventura，意为'偶然'——这个名字最初属于意外发明的金砂石玻璃。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, green aventurine is the Stone of Opportunity — traditionally used for luck and prosperity, and known as a comforting heart healer that dissolves negative emotions and brings emotional calm. US references list it as a go-to luck stone.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，绿东陵是'机遇之石'（Stone of Opportunity）——传统上用于好运与丰盛，也被称为抚慰心灵的疗愈石，能化解负面情绪、带来情绪安稳。美国资料把它列为首选幸运石。
uses_en: Job interviews, new ventures, a 'luck charm' pocket stone, abundance grids paired with citrine.
uses_zh: 求职面试、新事业起步、'幸运符'口袋石、与黄水晶搭配的丰盛晶阵。
viral_hook_en: 'Luckiest crystal' listicles; pair-with-citrine money rituals.
viral_hook_zh: '最幸运水晶'盘点内容；与黄水晶组 CP 的招财仪式。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend with a job interview or a new venture.
gift_angle_zh: 送给即将面试或开启新事业的朋友。

lore_en: Hematite is iron oxide (Fe₂O₃) with a metallic silver-black luster; its name comes from the Greek haima, 'blood,' because its streak is blood-red. It has been ground into red pigment since prehistory.
lore_zh: 赤铁矿是氧化铁（Fe₂O₃），呈银黑色金属光泽；名字源于希腊语 haima（血），因为它的条痕是血红色的。史前时代起它就被磨成红色颜料。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, hematite is called one of the most powerful grounding and protective stones — traditionally used to anchor scattered energy, sharpen the mind, and absorb and transmute negative energy into an energetic shield.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，赤铁矿被称为最强大的接地与保护石之一——传统上用于锚定涣散的能量、清明头脑，并吸收转化负能量为能量护盾。
uses_en: Grounding after meditation, focus work, men's jewelry and statement pendants, a pocket 'anchor.'
uses_zh: 冥想后接地、专注工作、男士珠宝与个性吊坠、口袋里的'锚'。
viral_hook_en: Magnetic 'hematine' (man-made) vs. real hematite tests are good authenticity content — disclose magnetic versions.
viral_hook_zh: 人造磁性'黑胆石' vs 天然赤铁矿的鉴别是不错的真伪科普内容——磁性款必须如实标注。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who feels 'floaty' after meditation or works a high-stress job.
gift_angle_zh: 送给冥想后容易'飘'、或工作高压的朋友。

lore_en: Howlite is a white calcium borosilicate with gray veining, named for the Canadian mineralogist Henry How. In the trade it is famous for a second reason: it is frequently dyed blue and sold as imitation turquoise — a classic US authenticity talking point.
lore_zh: 白纹石是带灰色纹路的白色硼硅酸钙矿物，以加拿大矿物学家 Henry How 命名。它在行业内出名的第二个原因：它常被染成蓝色冒充绿松石——这是美国市场经典的真伪科普话题。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, howlite is the Stone of Patience — a calming stone associated with patience and sleep support. Many people keep it by the bed to quiet a racing mind, and it is traditionally used to cool down stress and anger.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，白纹石是'耐心之石'——与耐心和睡眠支持相关联的安抚石。许多人把它放在床头让纷飞的思绪静下来，传统上也用它给压力和怒火'降温'。
uses_en: Bedside or under-pillow sleep stone, a 'cool down' stone for stressful moments, patience meditation.
uses_zh: 床头或枕下助眠石、压力时刻的'降温'石、耐心冥想。
viral_hook_en: Dyed-howlite-as-fake-turquoise callouts are popular authenticity content.
viral_hook_zh: '染色白纹石冒充绿松石'的打假内容是热门真伪科普题材。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend with a short fuse or a racing mind at night.
gift_angle_zh: 送给容易着急上火、或夜里思绪停不下来的朋友。

lore_en: Kunzite is the pink-violet variety of spodumene, named after George F. Kunz, the Tiffany & Co. gemologist who described it in the early 20th century. It is nicknamed the 'evening stone' because its color can fade in strong sunlight.
lore_zh: 紫锂辉石是锂辉石的粉紫色变种，以 20 世纪初蒂芙尼公司宝石学家 George F. Kunz 的名字命名。它有个外号叫'黄昏之石'，因为颜色在强烈阳光下会褪。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, kunzite is associated with unconditional, divine love and emotional openness through the heart chakra. It is traditionally used to dissolve negativity and is considered excellent for heart-centered meditation.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，紫锂辉石经由心轮与无条件的爱、神圣之爱和情感敞开相关联。传统上用它化解负能量，被认为非常适合以心为中心的冥想。
uses_en: Heart-healing meditation, love gifts, a gentle 'high vibration' display stone (kept out of direct sun).
uses_zh: 疗愈心轮的冥想、爱的礼物、温柔的'高频'陈列石（避免阳光直射）。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend healing from heartbreak.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正在走出心碎的朋友。

lore_en: Kyanite is a blue aluminum silicate that grows in bladed crystals; its name comes from the Greek kyanos, 'blue.' Its blades have a curious hardness quirk — softer along the blade, harder across it.
lore_zh: 蓝晶石是蓝色的硅酸铝矿物，呈刀片状晶体生长；名字源于希腊语 kyanos（蓝）。它的晶刃有个有趣的硬度特性——顺刃方向软、横刃方向硬。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, kyanite is the alignment stone — famous for the claim that it 'never needs cleansing.' It is traditionally believed to align all chakras, bridge the throat with the chakras above and below it, and support tranquility, communication, and psychic awareness.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，蓝晶石是'校准之石'——以'永远不需要净化'的说法闻名。传统上认为它能校准所有脉轮、把喉轮与上下脉轮连接起来，并带来宁静、沟通力与灵性觉知。
uses_en: Alignment meditation, dream recall, a 'bridge' stone in grids, communication work.
uses_zh: 校准冥想、梦境回忆、晶阵中的'桥梁'石、沟通练习。
viral_hook_en: 'The crystal that never needs cleansing' is a strong one-liner hook.
viral_hook_zh: '永远不需要净化的水晶'是很有力的一句话钩子。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who already owns crystals — no cleansing homework required.
gift_angle_zh: 送给已经在玩水晶的朋友——免去做'净化作业'的麻烦。

nicknames: Temple of the Stars (older card copy)
lore_en: Labradorite is a feldspar named after Labrador, Canada. In Inuit legend, the Northern Lights were trapped inside the stone — the 'frozen fire of the Aurora Borealis.' Its flashes of blue, green, and gold are an optical effect called labradorescence.
lore_zh: 拉长石是以加拿大拉布拉多地区命名的长石。因纽特人的传说中，北极光被封存在了石头里——'极光的冰冻之火'。它表面蓝、绿、金的闪光是一种光学效应，称为'拉长石晕彩'（labradorescence）。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, labradorite is the Stone of Magic and Transformation — traditionally used for intuition, new beginnings, and aura protection, and often recommended as a stone for empaths. Sellers describe it as filtering out negative energy while awakening inner sight.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，拉长石是'魔法与蜕变之石'——传统上用于直觉、新起点与气场保护，也常被推荐给共情者（empath）。卖家形容它过滤负能量的同时唤醒内在洞察力。
uses_en: Intuition meditation, bedside for dream recall, transformation moments, flash-reveal showpieces.
uses_zh: 直觉冥想、床头梦境回忆、人生蜕变时刻的陪伴、'闪光揭幕'展示件。
viral_hook_en: The 'flash reveal' rotation video is a top-performing crystal content format.
viral_hook_zh: '转光揭幕'旋转视频是水晶类目表现最好的内容形式之一。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend going through a big life change.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正在经历人生重大转变的朋友。

nicknames: Stone of Truth and Royalty (card copy)
lore_en: Lapis lazuli is a deep-blue rock of lazurite, calcite, and golden pyrite, prized since ancient Egypt — it adorns the sarcophagus of King Tutankhamun. Ground into ultramarine pigment, it was used to paint the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel.
lore_zh: 青金石是由青金岩（lazurite）、方解石和金色斑点的黄铁矿组成的深蓝色岩石，自古埃及时代备受珍视——图坦卡蒙法老的石棺上就有它。磨成群青颜料后，它被用来绘制西斯廷教堂的天顶画。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, lapis lazuli is the Stone of Wisdom — knowledge, truth, self-expression, and creative expression through the throat and third eye. It is called 'a performer's stone': wear it for auditions or public speaking.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，青金石是'智慧之石'——经由喉轮与眉心轮带来知识、真相、自我表达与创造力。它被称为'表演者之石'：试镜或公众演讲时佩戴它。
uses_en: Public speaking and performance, desk stone for creativity and communication, wisdom gifts.
uses_zh: 公众演讲与表演、激发创造力与沟通的书桌石、智慧赠礼。
viral_hook_en: Golden pyrite-fleck close-ups plus 'it painted the Sistine Chapel' trivia.
viral_hook_zh: 金色黄铁矿斑点特写，加上'它画过西斯廷教堂天顶'的冷知识。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend with an audition, a thesis defense, or a big speech.
gift_angle_zh: 送给即将试镜、答辩或重要演讲的朋友。

lore_en: Larimar is a rare blue pectolite found only in the Dominican Republic. Noted in 1916 and rediscovered in 1974 by Miguel Méndez, it was named for his daughter Larisa plus mar, the Spanish word for sea. The Dominican Republic established a national Day of Larimar (November 22) in 2018.
lore_zh: 海纹石是仅产于多米尼加共和国的稀有蓝色针钠钙石。1916 年首次被记录，1974 年由 Miguel Méndez 重新发现，他以女儿 Larisa 的名字加上西班牙语'海'（mar）为它命名。多米尼加 2018 年设立了国家'海纹石日'（11 月 22 日）。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, larimar carries calm, serenity, and soothing sea energy — traditionally used for relaxation, giving voice to wisdom, and calming emotional storms. It is a favorite for peaceful, ocean-breeze energy in a space.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，海纹石承载平静、安宁与舒缓的海洋能量——传统上用于放松、让智慧得以表达、平息情绪风暴。它是为空间带来海风和能量的宠儿。
uses_en: Calming jewelry for truth-telling conversations, spa and serenity decor, Caribbean and sea-themed shows.
uses_zh: 坦诚对话时的安抚首饰、水疗与宁静风陈设、加勒比与海洋主题直播。
viral_hook_en: 'A stone that only exists in one place on Earth' plus the Atlantis legend.
viral_hook_zh: '地球上只有一个地方出产的石头'，加上亚特兰蒂斯传说。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who needs the ocean on their desk.
gift_angle_zh: 送给需要把一片海放在办公桌上的朋友。

lore_en: Lepidolite is a lilac-colored mica that naturally contains lithium; its name comes from the Greek lepidos, 'scale,' for its flaky crystal habit. It is one of the most important lithium ores on Earth.
lore_zh: 锂云母是天然含锂的淡紫色云母，名字源于希腊语 lepidos（鳞片），形容它鳞片状的晶体形态。它是地球上最重要的锂矿石之一。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, lepidolite is the go-to calm stone — crystals.com calls it one of the most effective crystals for anxious feelings, thanks to its natural lithium content. It is traditionally used to steady an overactive mind and to support acceptance, hope, and life transitions. (Wellness framing only — never a medical claim.)
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，锂云母是首选的安抚石——crystals.com 称它因天然含锂而成为应对焦虑情绪最有效的水晶之一。传统上用于安定过度活跃的头脑，支持接纳、希望与人生过渡期。（仅限生活方式框架——绝不可作医疗宣称。）
uses_en: Bedside calm, a palm stone for stressful moments, support through transitions and grief.
uses_zh: 床头安抚石、压力时刻的掌心石、过渡期与哀伤期的陪伴。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend navigating a hard transition — a move, a breakup, a new chapter.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正在经历艰难过渡期的朋友——搬家、分手、或人生新篇章。

lore_en: Malachite is a green copper carbonate with hypnotic banded 'eye' patterns; its name comes from the Greek malache, 'mallow,' for its leaf-green color. It has been used since ancient Egypt as a pigment and protective amulet, and its bands were said to resemble the all-seeing eye.
lore_zh: 孔雀石是绿色碱式碳酸铜，带有迷人的'眼睛'状条带纹路；名字源于希腊语 malache（锦葵），取其叶绿色。自古埃及时代起它就被用作颜料与护身符，条带纹路被认为像'全视之眼'。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, malachite is the quintessential stone of transformation and protection — traditionally used to clear the way toward goals, absorb negative energy, and do deep heart work. Safety note: it contains copper, so never use it in water or elixirs, and its dust is toxic when cut.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，孔雀石是蜕变与保护的典范之石——传统上用于扫清通往目标的障碍、吸收负能量、进行深层的心轮功课。安全提示：它含铜，绝不可泡水或制作水晶能量水（elixir），切割粉尘有毒。
uses_en: Transformation moments, protection amulets, heart work, statement display pieces.
uses_zh: 人生蜕变时刻、护身符、心轮功课、个性陈列件。
viral_hook_en: Real-vs-fake malachite callout videos; hypnotic banding close-ups.
viral_hook_zh: 真假孔雀石打假视频；催眠感条带纹路特写。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend starting over — new city, new career, new chapter.
gift_angle_zh: 送给重新开始的朋友——新城市、新职业、新篇章。

lore_en: Moldavite is a green tektite glass formed about 15 million years ago by the Nördlinger Ries meteorite impact, found only in the Czech Republic's Moldau (Vltava) river valley — hence its name. Supply is finite, and it is widely considered the most-faked stone on the market.
lore_zh: 捷克陨石是约 1500 万年前德国讷德林根里斯陨石撞击形成的绿色玻陨石，仅产于捷克摩尔多瓦河（伏尔塔瓦河）流域——名字由此而来。储量有限，被普遍认为是市场上假货最多的石头。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, moldavite is the Holy Grail Stone of transformation — cosmic acceleration, rapid change, and synchronicity, with the famous marketing line 'you don't choose moldavite, it chooses you.' Many first-time holders report warmth or tingling, nicknamed 'the Moldavite Flush.' (No outcome is ever guaranteed — pair it with grounding stones.)
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，捷克陨石是蜕变的'圣杯之石'——宇宙级加速、快速转变与共时性，经典营销语是'不是你选择了捷克陨石，而是它选择了你'。许多初次接触者称感到发热或刺痛，被称为'捷克陨石潮红'（Moldavite Flush）。（绝不承诺任何结果——建议与接地石搭配使用。）
uses_en: Meditation accelerant, manifestation work, pairing with black tourmaline or smoky quartz to balance its intensity.
uses_zh: 冥想加速器、显化练习、与黑碧玺或茶晶搭配以平衡其强度。
viral_hook_en: TikTok 'it changed my life' testimonials, the Moldavite Flush, and fake-spotting content all went viral.
viral_hook_zh: TikTok 上'它改变了我的人生' testimonials、'潮红'体验和打假内容都曾爆火。
gift_angle_en: Not a casual gift — best for the crystal-obsessed friend who has been asking for one by name.
gift_angle_zh: 不适合随手送——最好留给点名想要它的资深水晶玩家朋友。

lore_en: Moonstone is a feldspar with adularescence — a milky blue glow that floats across the surface. The Romans believed it was formed from solidified moonbeams and held it sacred to Diana, goddess of the moon. It is the June birthstone.
lore_zh: 月光石是带有'冰长石晕彩'（adularescence）的长石——一层乳白色的蓝光在石面上浮动。古罗马人相信它是凝固的月光所化，将其献予月亮女神狄安娜。它是六月生辰石。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, moonstone is the Stone of New Beginnings — lunar, feminine energy tied to intuition, emotional balance, and the rhythms and cycles of life. Rainbow moonstone is the classic; peach moonstone is linked to the sacral chakra.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，月光石是'新起点之石'——月亮般的女性能量，关联直觉、情绪平衡与生命的节律周期。彩虹月光石是经典款；蜜桃月光石对应脐轮。
uses_en: New chapters (move, job, relationship), bedside intuition work, June birthday gifts, full-moon rituals.
uses_zh: 人生新篇章（搬家、新工作、新关系）、床头直觉练习、六月生日礼物、满月仪式。
viral_hook_en: Adularescence 'glow reveal' clips; full-moon charging rituals.
viral_hook_zh: 晕彩'浮光揭幕'短视频；满月充能仪式内容。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend starting a new chapter — a move, a job, a relationship.
gift_angle_zh: 送给开启人生新篇章的朋友——搬家、新工作或新恋情。

lore_en: Moss agate is a translucent chalcedony whose green dendritic inclusions of manganese and iron look like frozen moss. A fun script fact: despite the name, it is not a true agate at all — it has no banding.
lore_zh: 苔藓玛瑙是半透明玉髓，内部锰铁质的枝晶包裹体像被冻结的苔藓。一个有趣的直播知识点：尽管名字叫玛瑙，它其实根本不是真玛瑙——它没有条带结构。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, moss agate is associated with growth and abundance — the gardener's and farmer's stone, traditionally believed to encourage the growth of plants, projects, and businesses, and to uplift the mood through the heart chakra.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，苔藓玛瑙与成长和丰盛相关联——是园丁与农夫之石，传统上认为它能助益植物、项目和事业的生长，并经由心轮提振情绪。
uses_en: Tucked in with houseplants, new-business and garden abundance work, nature-themed gifts.
uses_zh: 摆在盆栽旁、新事业与园艺丰盛仪式、自然主题礼物。
viral_hook_en: 'Crystals styled with your houseplants' content is a proven US format.
viral_hook_zh: '水晶与室内绿植搭配'是美国市场验证过的内容形式。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a plant-parent friend — tuck it into a favorite pot.
gift_angle_zh: 送给'植物家长'朋友——直接埋进他最爱的花盆里。

lore_en: Obsidian is natural volcanic glass, used since prehistory for blades, arrowheads, and polished mirrors. Black is the classic; gold sheen and silver sheen varieties reveal a metallic glow when turned under light.
lore_zh: 黑曜石是天然火山玻璃，史前时代起就被用于制作刀刃、箭镞和抛光镜。黑色是经典款；金曜石与银曜石在光线下转动时会露出金属光泽。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, obsidian is the Warrior's Stone — psychic protection plus 'shadow work,' the practice of facing hidden truths. Gold sheen obsidian is traditionally used for manifestation, and silver sheen for scrying, mirror work, and intuition. (Zodiac assignments conflict across sources — treat as soft marketing only.)
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，黑曜石是'战士之石'——灵性保护加上'阴影功课'（shadow work），即直面隐藏的真相。金曜石传统上用于显化，银曜石用于镜占、观照与直觉。（各来源的星座归属互相矛盾——只作软性营销素材。）
uses_en: Protection grids, entryway placement, grounding work, mirror-like decor pieces, Halloween skull carvings.
uses_zh: 保护晶阵、入户门摆放、接地练习、镜面质感装饰件、万圣节骷髅雕件。
viral_hook_en: Sheen-obsidian flashlight reveals; obsidian skulls are a Halloween-season staple.
viral_hook_zh: 金曜/银曜的手电打光揭幕视频；黑曜石骷髅是万圣节档期的常驻爆款。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend doing deep personal work — a therapy-era companion stone.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正在做深度自我功课的朋友——心理疗愈期的陪伴石。

lore_en: Ocean jasper is an orbicular jasper found only in Madagascar, and the supply-chain story is real: the original deposits are worked at low tide, when the seams are accessible from the sea. Its signature 'orbs' — tiny spherical patterns — make every piece one of a kind.
lore_zh: 海洋碧玉是仅产于马达加斯加的球状碧玉，供应链故事是真实可查的：原生矿脉要在退潮时才能从海上靠近开采。它标志性的'眼睛'——细小的球状花纹——让每一件都独一无二。
metaphysical_en: In the US trade, ocean jasper is marketed as the Stone of Joy — a feel-good stone sellers reach for to lift the mood of a space. The orb patterns are the selling point: no two pieces are ever alike.
metaphysical_zh: 在美国市场，海洋碧玉被定位为'喜悦之石'（Stone of Joy）——卖家用它为空间带来好心情。球状花纹是最大卖点：世上没有两件相同的海洋碧玉。
uses_en: Spheres (which show the orbs best), palm stones, ocean-themed shows, mood-lifting desk decor.
uses_zh: 球体（最能展现眼纹）、掌心石、海洋主题直播、提振情绪的桌面陈设。
viral_hook_en: Orb-pattern close-ups plus the 'mined at low tide' supply-chain story.
viral_hook_zh: 眼纹特写，加上'退潮才能开采'的供应链故事。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend whose desk needs a little joy.
gift_angle_zh: 送给办公桌需要一点快乐的朋友。

lore_en: Opalite is man-made opalescent glass — no natural inclusions, no mine, no geological story. It is also sold as Sea Opal or Ice Cream Opal. US sellers handle it honestly: they disclose the man-made status, then sell the glow and the price. We do the same; it must never be sold as natural opal.
lore_zh: 欧泊蛋白石是人造的蛋白光玻璃——没有天然包裹体、没有矿、没有地质故事，也以 Sea Opal、Ice Cream Opal 等名字销售。美国卖家的合规做法是：公开人造身份，然后卖它的光泽和价格。我们同样如此；绝不可当作天然欧泊销售。
metaphysical_en: Even as a disclosed man-made stone, opalite gets metaphysical framing in the US community — traditionally associated with communication, clearing energy blockages, and mood stabilization. The accepted model is disclose first, then sell aesthetics and accessibility.
metaphysical_zh: 尽管如实标注为人造石，欧泊蛋白石在美国水晶圈仍有玄学定位——传统上与沟通、疏通能量卡点、稳定情绪相关联。公认的模式是：先如实披露，再卖颜值与亲和力。
uses_en: Budget-friendly glow pieces, entry-level gifts, teen-friendly first crystals, iridescent styling.
uses_zh: 平价的虹彩小件、入门礼物、青少年友好的第一块'水晶'、虹彩搭配。
viral_hook_en: Taylor Swift's 'Opalite' single (Aug 2025) produced a measurable spike in searches and sales — sellers openly rode the trend.
viral_hook_zh: Taylor Swift 的单曲《Opalite》（2025 年 8 月）带来可测量的搜索量与销量暴涨——卖家们公开借势营销。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a Swiftie friend — or a teen's very first 'crystal.'
gift_angle_zh: 送给霉霉粉丝朋友，或作为青少年的第一块'水晶'。

lore_en: Peridot is gem-quality olivine and the August birthstone. The best trivia in the category: tiny peridot crystals have been found inside meteorites — a genuine 'space gem.'
lore_zh: 橄榄石是宝石级橄榄石族矿物，八月生辰石。它拥有全类目最好的冷知识：陨石中发现过微小的橄榄石晶体——真正的'太空宝石'。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, peridot is seen as a protective, renewing stone linked to the heart chakra and the cycles of life — the GMSPB reference describes it as 'healing, protective… regulates life cycles.' (Wellness framing only.)
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，橄榄石被视为保护与新生的石头，关联心轮与生命节律——GMSPB 参考资料的表述是'疗愈、保护……调节生命周期'。（仅限生活方式框架。）
uses_en: August birthday gifts, heart-chakra work, meteorite-trivia content.
uses_zh: 八月生日礼物、心轮练习、陨石冷知识内容。
viral_hook_en: 'This gem has been found in meteorites' space trivia.
viral_hook_zh: '这种宝石在陨石里被发现过'的太空冷知识。
gift_angle_en: Gift for an August birthday — meteorite trivia card included.
gift_angle_zh: 送给八月生日的朋友——附上陨石冷知识小卡。

lore_en: Polychrome jasper is a swirling, desert-toned jasper from Madagascar, discovered in 2006 (one source says 2008 — the conflict is flagged in our research). Either way, 'a stone discovered in our lifetime' is a rare and verifiable narrative in this industry.
lore_zh: 多色碧玉是产自马达加斯加、带沙漠色漩涡纹的碧玉，发现于 2006 年（另有来源称 2008 年——研究中已标注分歧）。无论如何，'一块在我们有生之年被发现的石头'是这个行业里少见且可验证的叙事。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, polychrome jasper blends joy with grounding — traditionally used for comfort and steadiness through change. Zodiac assignments vary by shop; treat them as marketing-only.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，多色碧玉把喜悦与接地结合在一起——传统上用于在变动中获得安慰与稳定。各店铺的星座归属不一，只作营销素材。
uses_en: Grounding decor, support through transitions, earthy-palette styling.
uses_zh: 接地感陈设、过渡期陪伴、大地色系搭配。
viral_hook_en: 'A stone discovered in our lifetime' rarity framing.
viral_hook_zh: '在我们有生之年才发现的石头'的稀缺叙事。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend in a life transition who loves earthy tones.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正处人生过渡、又偏爱大地色系的朋友。

nicknames: The Stone That Heals the Healer
lore_en: Prehnite holds a special place in mineral history: it was the first mineral ever named after a person — Colonel Hendrik von Prehn, who brought it from South Africa in the 18th century. Its soft grape-green color matches its Chinese name perfectly.
lore_zh: 葡萄石在矿物学史上地位特殊：它是人类历史上第一种以人名命名的矿物——纪念 18 世纪把它从南非带回的 Hendrik von Prehn 上校。它柔和的葡萄绿色与中文名完美呼应。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, prehnite is 'the stone that heals the healer' — traditionally kept by caregivers, therapists, and nurses as a restorative stone for the heart and solar plexus. An underused but powerful gifting position.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，葡萄石是'疗愈疗愈者的石头'——传统上由照护者、治疗师、护士随身持有，作为修复心轮与太阳轮的复原石。这是一个被低估但极有潜力的送礼定位。
uses_en: Gifts for caregivers, heart meditation, a restorative desk stone for helping professions.
uses_zh: 送给照护者的礼物、心轮冥想、助人行业人士的复原桌面石。
gift_angle_en: Gift for your therapist, nurse, teacher, or caregiver friend — the classic 'heals the healer' gift.
gift_angle_zh: 送给做治疗师、护士、教师或照护工作的朋友——经典的'疗愈疗愈者'礼物。

lore_en: Pyrite's brassy gold glitter fooled generations of gold-rush prospectors — hence Fool's Gold. Its name comes from the Greek pyr, 'fire,' because it throws sparks when struck against steel. Natural cubic crystals are its signature.
lore_zh: 黄铁矿黄铜色的金光骗过了一代又一代淘金者——故称'愚人金'。名字源于希腊语 pyr（火），因为它与钢铁相击能迸出火花。天然立方体晶体是它的标志。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, pyrite is an abundance and willpower stone for the solar plexus — traditionally used in prosperity rituals, confidence work, and creativity. Its classic placement mirrors citrine's: the cash register, the wallet, the desk.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，黄铁矿是对应太阳轮的丰盛与意志力之石——传统上用于招财仪式、自信练习与创造力。它的经典摆位与黄水晶相同：收银台、钱包、办公桌。
uses_en: Money-corner desk placement, manifestation grids, cube-cluster display pieces.
uses_zh: '财位角'桌面摆放、显化晶阵、立方体晶簇陈列件。
viral_hook_en: 'Fool's gold that works harder than real gold' money-corner content.
viral_hook_zh: '比真金更努力的愚人金'财位角内容。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend launching a side hustle.
gift_angle_zh: 送给刚开启副业的朋友。

lore_en: Jasper's name comes through the French jaspre, from older words for 'spotted stone.' The whole jasper family carries the trade nickname 'Supreme Nurturer,' and red jasper is its bold, brick-red anchor stone.
lore_zh: 'Jasper'一词经由法语 jaspre 演变而来，更古老的词源意为'有斑点的石头'。整个碧玉家族在业内共享'至高滋养者'（Supreme Nurturer）的外号，红碧玉则是其中砖红色的锚定之石。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, red jasper is the root-chakra stone of strength and stamina — traditionally used for steady endurance, grounding, and quiet courage over the long haul.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，红碧玉是对应海底轮的力量与耐力之石——传统上用于持久的韧性、接地与不张扬的勇气。
uses_en: An endurance pocket stone, grounding work, workout-bag or desk anchor.
uses_zh: 耐力随身石、接地练习、健身包或办公桌上的锚定石。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend training for a marathon — or grinding through a tough season.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正在备战马拉松、或咬牙熬过艰难时期的朋友。

lore_en: Rhodonite is rose-pink manganese silicate shot through with black veining; its name comes from the Greek rhodon, 'rose.' The pink-and-black contrast makes it one of the most recognizable stones in the trade.
lore_zh: 蔷薇辉石是蔷薇粉色的硅酸锰矿物，穿插黑色纹路；名字源于希腊语 rhodon（蔷薇）。粉黑撞色的外观让它成为业内辨识度最高的石头之一。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, rhodonite is the Stone of Compassion — traditionally used for forgiveness and emotional first aid through the heart chakra. It is the stone people reach for when mending a relationship — including the one with themselves.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，蔷薇辉石是'慈悲之石'——传统上经由心轮用于宽恕与'情绪急救'。当人们想修复一段关系时——包括与自己的关系——就会拿起它。
uses_en: Reconciliation gifts, heart-healing meditation, self-forgiveness work.
uses_zh: 和解礼物、疗愈心轮的冥想、自我宽恕练习。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend you are reconciling with — or one practicing self-forgiveness.
gift_angle_zh: 送给你想与之和解的朋友，或正在练习自我原谅的朋友。

lore_en: Rose quartz is the soft-pink variety of quartz, colored by trace mineral inclusions. In the US market it is simply the best-known 'love stone' on earth — verified by two independent references as the Stone of Unconditional Love — and it anchors the entire self-love ritual category.
lore_zh: 粉水晶是石英的柔粉色变种，颜色来自微量矿物包裹体。在美国市场，它就是地球上最知名的'爱情石'——有两个独立来源验证其'无条件之爱之石'的头衔——并支撑着整个'自爱仪式'品类。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, rose quartz is the Stone of Unconditional Love — heart chakra, Venus energy, and the core message that self-love comes first. It is the default stone for love and relationships in every US shop, from tumbled pocket stones to heart carvings.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，粉水晶是'无条件之爱之石'——心轮、金星能量，以及'自爱先行'的核心信息。从美国每家店铺的滚石到爱心雕件，它都是爱与关系主题的默认之选。
uses_en: Self-love rituals, bedroom and desk placement, love gifts, Valentine's season, heart carvings.
uses_zh: 自爱仪式、卧室与桌面摆放、爱情礼物、情人节档期、爱心雕件。
viral_hook_en: Self-love ritual content; heart carvings are a Valentine's-season staple.
viral_hook_zh: 自爱仪式类内容；爱心雕件是情人节档期的常驻款。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend learning to put themselves first — the self-love icon.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正在学习把自己放在第一位的朋友——自爱代言人。

lore_en: Selenite is a variety of gypsum named for Selene, the Greek goddess of the moon, for its moonlit, pearly glow. It is very soft (Mohs 2) and water-soluble — the one crystal you must never soak.
lore_zh: 透石膏是石膏的一个变种，因月光般的珍珠光泽以希腊月亮女神塞勒涅（Selene）命名。它非常软（莫氏 2）且溶于水——这是唯一一种绝不可泡水的'水晶'。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, selenite is Liquid Light — famous for the twin claims that it cleanses other crystals and never needs cleansing itself. Linked to the crown chakra, it is traditionally used for clarity, peace, and energetic maintenance of a whole collection.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，透石膏是'流动的光'（Liquid Light）——以'能净化其他水晶、自身永不需要净化'的双重说法闻名。它对应顶轮，传统上用于清明、平和，以及为整个水晶收藏做能量维护。
uses_en: Cleansing stations, wands, charging bowls and plates — the 'infrastructure' stone every crystal buyer needs; a natural cross-sell with every order.
uses_zh: 净化台、净化棒、充能碗与充能盘——每个水晶玩家都需要的'基础设施'石；天然适合随单加购。
viral_hook_en: 'How I cleanse my crystals' routine content — selenite is always the star.
viral_hook_zh: '我是怎么净化水晶的'日常内容——透石膏永远是主角。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who just started collecting — they need a cleansing tool.
gift_angle_zh: 送给刚入坑收藏的朋友——他们需要一件净化工具。

nicknames: Dragon Egg (⚠️ name collision with Dragon's Blood Jasper)
lore_en: Septarian nodules are 50–70-million-year-old Cretaceous concretions of calcite, aragonite, and limestone, cracked into their signature 'turtle-back' pattern. The name comes from the Latin septum, 'partition.' Polished egg shapes are sold as Dragon Eggs.
lore_zh: 龟背石是 5000–7000 万年前白垩纪的结核，由方解石、文石与灰岩组成，裂成标志性的'龟背'纹路。名字源于拉丁语 septum（隔板）。抛光的蛋形件以'龙蛋'之名销售。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, septarian is a confidence and public-speaking stone — traditionally used across the root, sacral, and solar plexus chakras for grounded, earthy self-assurance. Element associations: Earth and Fire.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，龟背石是自信与公众演讲之石——传统上横跨海底轮、脐轮与太阳轮，带来脚踏实地的笃定感。元素对应：土与火。
uses_en: Dragon-egg carvings, speaking-confidence pocket stone, display spheres with the crackled pattern.
uses_zh: 龙蛋雕件、演讲自信随身石、龟裂纹展示球。
viral_hook_en: Dragon-egg carvings and 'older than the dinosaurs' extinction-era trivia.
viral_hook_zh: 龙蛋雕件，以及'比恐龙灭绝还早'的年代冷知识。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who presents for a living — and loves dragons.
gift_angle_zh: 送给以演讲为业、又喜欢龙的朋友。

lore_en: Shungite is a roughly 2-billion-year-old carbon stone found only in Karelia, Russia, and it naturally contains fullerenes — the C60 molecules whose discovery won the 1996 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. Legend holds that Peter the Great established a spa around shungite spring water. Elite (noble) shungite is the high-carbon grade.
lore_zh: 次石墨是约 20 亿年历史的碳质石头，仅产于俄罗斯卡累利阿，天然含有富勒烯——C60 分子的发现曾获 1996 年诺贝尔化学奖。传说彼得大帝曾围绕次石墨泉水建立疗养院。'精英级'（noble）次石墨是高碳含量等级。
metaphysical_en: In the US market, shungite's dominant narrative is EMF-conscious living — it is popular in the EMF-conscious community for placement near phones, routers, and laptops. Compliance note: lifestyle framing only; it is not a medical device, and we never make health claims about EMF.
metaphysical_zh: 在美国市场，次石墨的主流叙事是'关注电磁辐射的生活方式'——在 EMF 关注社群中常用于手机、路由器、电脑旁的摆放。合规提示：仅限生活方式框架；它不是医疗器械，我们绝不对 EMF 作任何健康宣称。
uses_en: Desk placement near electronics, protection-themed decor, collector-grade elite pieces.
uses_zh: 电子设备旁的桌面摆放、保护主题陈设、收藏级精英次石墨。
viral_hook_en: Phone-on-shungite 'EMF test' videos are everywhere — keep our framing strictly lifestyle-only.
viral_hook_zh: '手机放在次石墨上'的 EMF 测试视频随处可见——我们的表述必须严格限于生活方式框架。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a tech-worker friend building an 'EMF-conscious' desk setup (disclaimer included).
gift_angle_zh: 送给想打造'EMF 关注型'办公桌的码农朋友（随附免责声明）。

lore_en: Smoky quartz is quartz colored smoky brown-to-black by natural irradiation over geological time. It holds a unique title: it is the national gemstone of Scotland, where it is called cairngorm after the Cairngorm Mountains.
lore_zh: 茶晶是石英在地质年代中经天然辐照形成的烟褐至黑色变种。它拥有一个独特头衔：苏格兰的国石，在苏格兰以产地凯恩戈姆山脉命名为 cairngorm。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, smoky quartz is a premier grounding stone — traditionally used to anchor energy through the root and earth-star chakras and to transmute negativity into usable, steady energy.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，茶晶是顶级的接地石——传统上用于经由海底轮与地星轮锚定能量，并把负能量转化为稳定可用的能量。
uses_en: Grounding anchor for meditation, entryway placement, desk stone, unisex styling.
uses_zh: 冥想接地锚石、入户门摆放、桌面石、中性风搭配。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who overthinks — the 'stay rooted' stone.
gift_angle_zh: 送给容易想太多的朋友——'保持扎根'之石。

lore_en: Sodalite is a royal-blue feldspathoid mineral, usually veined with white calcite, and frequently mistaken for lapis lazuli. It is named for its high sodium content.
lore_zh: 方钠石是宝蓝色的似长石矿物，通常带白色方解石纹路，常被误认为青金石。名字源于其高钠含量。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, sodalite is the Stone of Logic — traditionally believed to unite rational thinking with intuition across the third eye and throat chakras. It is the thinker's stone: analysis plus inner knowing.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，方钠石是'逻辑之石'——传统上认为它能在眉心轮与喉轮之间把理性思维与直觉合一。它是思考者之石：分析力加上内在洞见。
uses_en: Study and writing desk stone, clarity meditation, a thinker's gift.
uses_zh: 学习与写作书桌石、清明冥想、送给思考者的礼物。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a writer or analyst friend — logic plus intuition.
gift_angle_zh: 送给写作或分析工作的朋友——逻辑与直觉兼得。

lore_en: Strawberry quartz is pink-to-red quartz whose 'strawberry seeds' are really tiny iron-oxide inclusions. It is a modern market favorite rather than a stone with ancient lore — its story is being written right now on livestreams.
lore_zh: 草莓晶是粉至红色的石英，那些'草莓籽'其实是微小的氧化铁包裹体。它不是拥有古老传说的石头，而是现代市场的新宠——它的故事正在直播间里被书写。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, strawberry quartz is the Stone of Inner Love — a gentle heart-chakra stone traditionally used for self-worth and self-appreciation. (Some sources add crown or root chakra — flagged as inconsistent.)
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，草莓晶是'内在之爱之石'——温柔的心轮石，传统上用于自我价值与自我欣赏。（部分来源还加入顶轮或海底轮——已标注不一致。）
uses_en: Cute-aesthetic shows, heart work, sweet gifts, pink-themed styling.
uses_zh: 少女感主题直播、心轮练习、甜美礼物、粉色系搭配。
viral_hook_en: A proven performer in cute-aesthetic 'pink show' streams.
viral_hook_zh: 在少女向'粉色专场'直播中是被验证的爆款相。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend on a self-love journey who loves cute aesthetics.
gift_angle_zh: 送给走在自爱之路上、又热爱可爱风的朋友。

lore_en: Sunstone is a feldspar spangled with glittering metallic flashes — an optical effect called aventurescence or schiller, caused by tiny copper or hematite platelets inside the stone. Oregon claims it as its state gemstone.
lore_zh: 太阳石是闪烁金属光泽的长石——这种光学效应称为砂金效应（aventurescence/schiller），由石内微小的铜或赤铁矿片晶造成。俄勒冈州将其奉为州宝石。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, sunstone carries joy and leadership — traditionally used for optimism, personal power, and warm self-confidence across the sacral and solar plexus chakras. It is the Leo stone par excellence.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，太阳石承载喜悦与领导力——传统上经由脐轮与太阳轮用于乐观、个人力量与温暖的自信。它是当之无愧的狮子座之石。
uses_en: Leadership and confidence work, desk stone, morning-routine rituals.
uses_zh: 领导力与自信练习、桌面石、晨间仪式。
viral_hook_en: Schiller-flash rotation clips — the stone literally glitters on camera.
viral_hook_zh: 砂金闪光旋转特写——这块石头在镜头前真的会闪。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend stepping into a leadership role.
gift_angle_zh: 送给刚走上领导岗位的朋友。

lore_en: Tiger's eye is quartz that has replaced crocidolite asbestos fibers while keeping their structure — producing its famous cat's-eye band of light (chatoyancy). Legend says Roman soldiers wore it for courage in battle; we present that as legend, not history.
lore_zh: 虎眼石是石英交代青石棉纤维、并保留其纤维结构而成的假像石英——由此产生著名的猫眼状光带（chatoyancy）。传说古罗马士兵佩戴它以在战场上获得勇气；我们将其表述为传说而非史实。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing tradition, tiger's eye is the solar-plexus stone of courage, confidence, and willpower — traditionally carried before big moments and beloved in men's bracelets. It is the classic Leo stone.
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈传统中，虎眼石是对应太阳轮的勇气、自信与意志力之石——传统上在重大时刻随身携带，也是男士手链的宠儿。它是经典的狮子座之石。
uses_en: Confidence before big moments, men's and unisex bracelets, a pocket stone for interviews and first dates.
uses_zh: 重大时刻前的自信石、男士与中性手链、面试和初次约会的口袋石。
viral_hook_en: The chatoyancy (cat's-eye band) reveal under a light is a ready-made close-up shot.
viral_hook_zh: 灯光下猫眼效应（chatoyancy）的揭幕是现成的特写镜头。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend facing something that scares them — an interview, a first date, a big game.
gift_angle_zh: 送给正面临挑战的朋友——面试、初次约会或重要比赛。

lore_en: Unakite is a mottled green-and-pink stone named after the Unaka Mountains of North Carolina and Tennessee — a genuinely American-named crystal. It is granite altered by hydrothermal fluids into its signature pistachio-and-salmon pattern.
lore_zh: 花绿石是绿粉斑驳的石头，以美国北卡罗来纳与田纳西交界的尤纳卡（Unaka）山脉命名——一块真正以美国地名命名的水晶。它是花岗岩经热液蚀变形成的，呈现标志性的开心果绿配鲑鱼粉花纹。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, unakite is the Stone of Vision — traditionally used for personal growth by balancing the heart and third eye chakras. (We deliberately skip the fertility/pregnancy framing some US sellers use.)
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，花绿石是'愿景之石'（Stone of Vision）——传统上通过平衡心轮与眉心轮助力个人成长。（我们刻意不使用部分美国卖家的生育/孕期框架。）
uses_en: Growth meditation, garden and nature pairing, American-heritage storytelling.
uses_zh: 成长冥想、园艺与自然搭配、美国本土故事内容。
viral_hook_en: 'The crystal named after American mountains' heritage angle.
viral_hook_zh: '以美国山脉命名的水晶'本土情怀角度。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a friend who loves the Appalachian Trail — or American-made stories.
gift_angle_zh: 送给热爱阿巴拉契亚步道、或喜欢美国本土故事的朋友。

lore_en: Yooperlite was discovered in 2017 by Erik Rintamaki on the Lake Superior shore of Michigan's Upper Peninsula — a rock that looks ordinary gray until a 365nm UV flashlight makes it blaze orange from the fluorescent sodalite inside. It is one of the youngest 'named' stones on the market.
lore_zh: Yooperlite 于 2017 年由 Erik Rintamaki 在密歇根上半岛的苏必利尔湖畔发现——外表普通的灰色石头，用 365nm 紫外手电一照，内部的荧光方钠石就会燃起橙色光芒。它是市场上最年轻的'命名'石头之一。
metaphysical_en: In the crystal healing community, yooperlite is the Stone of Truth — linked to the throat chakra and traditionally used for honest self-expression. (Disclosure: Indian fluorescent sodalite is openly sold as 'like Yooperlite' — origin must always be stated.)
metaphysical_zh: 在水晶疗愈社群中，Yooperlite 是'真相之石'——对应喉轮，传统上用于真诚的自我表达。（披露提示：印度产荧光方钠石被公开以'类 Yooperlite'名义销售——产地必须如实标注。）
uses_en: UV-reveal party pieces, collectors of 'new' stones, conversation decor, bundled with a UV flashlight.
uses_zh: UV 揭幕派对件、'新石头'收藏家、话题性陈设、与紫外手电组合销售。
viral_hook_en: The UV-lamp reveal is the strongest short-video format in the entire category.
viral_hook_zh: 紫外灯揭幕是整个类目里最强的短视频形式。
gift_angle_en: Gift for a rockhound friend or Michigan lover — bundle it with a UV flashlight.
gift_angle_zh: 送给石头控朋友或密歇根迷——搭配一支紫外手电一起送。
